author: Keel (brief 098 step 0, 2026-11-07)
rule: The dial (brief 098 step 0; Sky 2026-11-07: "I should say, add 3 more guards, take some away, bring in more cars etc - the game then just does that, no long processing, and I play and get a feel"). A start sets how many of each kind the zone has (start.counts: guards and people, the whole zone's count of that kind, the cast included; cars, how many are on the zone's roads at a time on average); the engine builds that world when the game starts, from the seed and these rules, with no generator run. A kind the start does not set plays the people file exactly, and a start that sets none hashes and plays as before: this file is read only when a start sets counts, and then its text is hashed into that start, so seed + counts + orders replay exactly against it. Part of Keel's rulebook (contracts/rules/rulebook.json keeps its own bytes, so no recorded run moves). Unknown = reject.

guards.name: Guard
guards.src: brief 098 step 0: the people file's guards (job guard; 16 in the Handover, the door guard among them) plus any the dial adds; people.rules temperamentsBy.roles.guard (Loyal or Mercenary, never Idealist or Fearful)
guards.reason: an added guard is named by a stand-in (Guard 1, Guard 2, ...): the engine has no name rules (the names are drawn by the people generator from contracts/people/names at build time). 400 keeps a hopeless setting playable in time.

people.name: Passer-by
people.src: brief 098 step 0: everyone else in the people file (114 in the Handover, Inez, the driver and Popovic among them) plus any the dial adds; people.rules temperamentsBy.roles.visitor (a simulated person who neither lives nor works in the district)
people.reason: an added person is a passer-by named by a stand-in (Passer-by 1, ...), for the reason above. They carry no need record (the cell turns only the cast: Ask, Help and Pressure are never offered to the crowd) and no ties.

cars.src: brief 098 step 1 (law L8; Sky 2026-11-07: "our roads are empty, no reason can't have passing traffic"; "bring in more cars etc - the game then just does that"): passing cars on the zone's lanes (sim/data/handover.lanes.json), each a real car of the engine (GameCars.cs, Sky 2026-10-21: "shootable, as in Syndicate"): a target, solid, and cover where it stands
cars.reason: a count is how many cars are on the zone's roads (inside the walk window) at a time on average: the engine runs enough of them through the mouths, each trip a new car (car:t-<slot>-<trip>) with a stand-in driver at the wheel. 0 today (the roads are empty); unset is no traffic at all. 64 is about every lane full at its gap: a hopeless setting still plays in time.

fewer.src: brief 098 step 0: people above the count leave by a stable order, never a tenet; GDD §05 security: a post is one person's, a relief waits beside it and keeps its marks
fewer.reason: the order is a hash of each person's id (fnv1a32 of id/salt, ties by id), the same every game and every seed, so a count is one world shape and the seed moves only its timings, and taking one more away never brings anyone back. Never a tenet: the mission's cast (the site's cast) and anyone a cast member's lover tie names. Guards leave off-post ones first; then a post's reliefs, the latest shift first, the one before standing the post on to the end of the shift that left; then the posts themselves: a post is staffed for its whole shift or not at all, never half.

beat.src: brief 098 step 0: an added guard is on shift, on a beat between post points the engine finds in the site: its staffed doors (a point doorOutCm out of the door, so the door's own post stays its holder's), its police posts (the takedown file's street posts) and its call boxes (which stand at the corners, R-REPORT); GDD §05 every staff post checks in by voice every 90 s from the start of its shift (rulebook check-in-period-s)
beat.reason: a beat is size points: the guard's first post point (spread over the points in a seeded order, one guard to a point before any shares) and the size - 1 nearest to it, walked in a loop at the city's walk (crowd.walk), pausing pauseS at each, facing out of the door or to the kerb. His shift runs from shiftBeforeS before 0:00 to shiftAfterS after the close, at a seeded phase; his marks run every check-in period from it. The site carries no gates yet (the plan's gates are not in the sim site), so a beat finds none. Pulse to tune.

passers.src: brief 098 step 0: an added city person is a passer-by who enters at the site's edges at a seeded time, walks to a seeded destination, lingers and leaves
passers.reason: the edges are the runs of free cells on the walk grid's border (a street or a path leaving the window), at least edgeMinCells wide, entered at the middle of each; a run longer than edgeSpanCells (a street along the border) is split evenly, so people come in along it, not at one point. A passer-by enters at a seeded second in enterS (mission seconds; before 0:00 they are already walking when the mission starts) and goes to a destination by these weights: a café seat (the people file's chairs) free for the whole linger, sitting there lingerS.seat; a public door of the site's buildings (the café, the Office), inside for lingerS.door; or another edge, walking straight through. Then out by a seeded edge. The site has no benches or transit stops yet, so neither is a destination. Temperament: the role's allow list (people.rules temperamentsBy.roles), weighted by the zone's own mix of that kind, no temperament above temperamentsBy.mix.rowMaxShare. Pulse to tune.

traffic.src: brief 098 step 1, law L8 (Sky 2026-11-07: "Drivers keep to their lanes, stop for people in the road and for cars ahead ... brake or flee at gunfire. Roads close in a lockdown. A car is a car: it can be shot, hidden behind or blown up"): the kit's vehicles at budget (out/world/harbour-district.presentation.json models: car/* the sedans, van/box BoxTruck_Play, scooter/hover HoverScooter; its notes: vans 8 %, scooters 4 % of traffic); size [length, width] cm, the models' footprints (the sedan's is the rulebook's car.footprint); cover, the kinds a body can hide behind
traffic.reason: each trip draws its kind by the mix; its footprint is what it blocks on the walk grid, its gap and its cover. Every kind is a car under the rulebook's car.target (health, disabled, burning, the blast); a standing sedan or van is cover on its four sides as the mission's cars are (their sides' and ends' cover, the site's car points), a scooter none. Forma's civilian set at budget replaces the sedans' repaints later.

drive.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 lanes and stopping: a driver keeps to the lane's line at its speed (the lanes file: life.json traffic.byClass speed), keeps gapCm plus headwayDs tenths of a second of its speed behind whatever is ahead in its lane within lookCm (a car, the cell, the city's people, the cast, a body), and stops peopleGapCm short of a person; the corridor it keeps clear is its width plus clearCm each side
drive.reason: a city driver's 1.2 s headway and 2 m standstill gap; 2 m/s2 to pull away, 4.5 m/s2 to brake, 8 m/s2 at a sudden alarm (a hard stop); 25 m ahead is what a driver at 5 m/s watches; 30 cm each side keeps two cars in neighbouring lanes apart. Pulse to tune.

trips.src: brief 098 step 1: each slot of the count runs one car at a time through the zone: in at a seeded mouth, out at another, then a seeded offS before its next trip (a new car); the game starts with warmS of traffic already run, so the roads are full at 0:00
trips.reason: enough slots that the mean on the zone's roads is the count (the slots' share of time inside the window, from the routes' lengths at their speeds); every draw is the slot's own (seed, slot, trip), so a higher count adds slots and moves no car already there

stand.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 a car is a car: a car stopped standS is standing (rulebook car.footprint: ground nobody walks through; car.box: on a way out it boxes it in; cover where it stands); one stopped settleS (or disabled, burning, abandoned, its driver ducked) is settled: the crowd's routine legs set out round it, as round the mission's standing cars
stand.reason: a car pausing for someone crossing is not yet a wall; a queue that waits is. The crowd's legs are walked again only for settled cars, so a queue's stop and go does not re-walk the city each second.

pass.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 stopping: a driver held up waitS behind something that will not move on (a standing mission car, a wreck or an abandoned car, a body) eases round it within its own half of the road when there is room, at latCmS across and passCmS along; with no room there, out across the centreline as far as the oncoming lane's line when that lane holds no car that could meet it before it is past (an overtake: meanwhile no junction lets a car into that lane); round a person on their feet only once they have stayed in the road 5 waitS, a body's width wider. Seen from afar the driver eases out early, still rolling; stopped too close to swing out, they back off up to backCm where the road behind is clear, and try again
pass.reason: the official car at its kerbside stop and the rival car's block reach into a lane by less than its spare width: drivers squeeze by. A car or a person that fills the lane (the rival wheelman standing in Apron Road by his parked car) is overtaken when the other way is clear; while it is not, the cars behind it wait and the rest find another way at the junction before.

yield.src: brief 098 step 1: the mission's cars (the getaway car, the official car, the rival car) drive their own timetables (tenets); traffic yields to them by the same law: a moving mission car's next aheadS of road is a car in the way (unless it comes up from behind: the driver ahead drives on), a driver it comes at pulls aside within their half where there is room, and no junction is entered that it will cross within aheadS; and a mission car is a car: one whose next place would meet a passing car on its way holds that tick (its leg's clock waits), at most holdS in a row, then drives on
yield.reason: 3 s at 5 m/s is 15 m: a driver sees a car coming and lets it by. A mission car waits for a passing car at most holdS at a time: a car on its way clears in seconds, a ducked driver sits up crowd.quiet (30 s) after the last shot, so 40 s outlasts both and no seed or jam holds it for good. It never waits for a car that stands for good (a wreck, an abandoned car): a leg it starts goes round those (the drive grid's route round their ground), and one shot to a wreck across a leg already under way it passes, as the mission's cars pass one another's wrecks today.

react.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 gunfire (Sky 2026-11-07: "Pull a gun out in front of someone they run away ... based on their nature"): a driver who hears a shot within crowd.scatter of the car, or sees a drawn weapon in their cone (perception.people, the car's heading their facing), brakes hard and stops; then by nature they duck at the wheel until it has been quiet crowd.quiet, or drive off fast (fleePm per mille of the lane's speed) the way they were going, still stopping for anyone in the road; a driver whose car is shot gets out and runs (the crowd's flight)
react.reason: the Fearful freeze and the Loyal wait for the police; the Mercenary and the Idealist want out. The startle before acting is the crowd's (crowd.startle, the Fearful's shorter). A ducked driver sees nothing. Motive to set the natures' answers with step 2's witness laws.

lockdown.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 roads close: from this Alert (3, lockdown) no car comes in: an inbound car stops short of the window's edge; the cars already in the zone carry on out (leave) or pull up where they are (stop)
lockdown.reason: leave: a sealed street empties of cars, so traffic never boxes the cell's car in for the rest of the mission; stop is the other reading of Sky's "roads close".

driver.name: Driver
driver.src: brief 098 step 1, L8 drivers are people: each car's driver is a person with a temperament from people.rules temperamentsBy.roles.visitor (weighted by the zone's own mix of people, the dial's rule), who sees by their cone and reacts by their nature; out of their car they are a passer-by of the crowd (they witness, scatter, block sight)
driver.reason: a driver passing through neither lives nor works in the district: a visitor. Stand-in names (Driver 1, ...) as the dial's added people; no need record, no ties. At the wheel a driver reports nothing (news travels on foot: step 2's witness laws decide what a driver who saw something does).
